description: Cleaned synteny figure: USDA110 bll6421-bll6430 versus the H. seropedicae fde operon
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, matplotlib.patches as mp, numpy as np
bj=[("bll6430",7078565,7079542,"-","SphA family"),("blr6429",7077548,7078477,"+","LysR regulator"),
    ("bll6428",7076273,7077430,"-","alpha/beta hydrolase"),("bll6427",7075294,7076247,"-","VOC dioxygenase"),
    ("bll6426",7074942,7075310,"-","Rieske 2Fe-2S"),("bll6425",7073772,7074902,"-","FAD oxidoreductase"),
    ("bll6424",7072529,7073692,"-","MFS transporter"),("bll6423",7071925,7072503,"-","cupin"),
    ("bll6422",7070894,7071928,"-","FAH family"),("bll6421",7069951,7070889,"-","NAD epim./dehydratase")]
hs=[("fdeR",1109847,1110776,"-","LysR regulator"),("fdeA",1111119,1111982,"+","SphA family"),
    ("fdeB",1112013,1113173,"+","alpha/beta hydrolase"),("fdeC",1113202,1114128,"+","VOC dioxygenase"),
    ("fdeD",1114173,1114511,"+","Rieske 2Fe-2S"),("fdeE",1114544,1115674,"+","FAD monooxygenase"),
    ("fdeF",1115752,1116906,"+","MFS transporter"),("fdeG",1116903,1117718,"+","cyclase"),
    ("fdeH",1117742,1118332,"+","cupin"),("fdeI",1118336,1119319,"+","FAH family"),
    ("fdeJ",1119316,1120278,"+","NAD epim./dehydratase")]
pid={"bll6430":45.9,"blr6429":48.0,"bll6428":81.2,"bll6427":59.4,"bll6426":49.0,"bll6425":54.0,
     "bll6424":56.6,"bll6423":67.0,"bll6422":61.7,"bll6421":48.9}
partner={"bll6430":"fdeA","blr6429":"fdeR","bll6428":"fdeB","bll6427":"fdeC","bll6426":"fdeD","bll6425":"fdeE",
         "bll6424":"fdeF","bll6423":"fdeH","bll6422":"fdeI","bll6421":"fdeJ"}
lfc={"bll6430":0.16,"blr6429":-0.11,"bll6428":1.25,"bll6427":1.73,"bll6426":1.26,"bll6425":1.50,
     "bll6424":1.00,"bll6423":0.93,"bll6422":0.52,"bll6421":0.93}
# x in kb; B.d. reverse-complemented and anchored so bll6428 start aligns with fdeB start
xb={n:(-( (e-7077430)/1000.0), -((s-7077430)/1000.0)) for n,s,e,_,_ in bj}   # (left,right)
xh={n:((s-1112013)/1000.0,(e-1112013)/1000.0) for n,s,e,_,_ in hs}
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(14.5,6.4))
def arrow(a,b,y,fwd,col):
    h=0.17; tip=min(0.13,(b-a)*0.45)
    pts=[(a,y-h),(b-tip,y-h),(b,y),(b-tip,y+h),(a,y+h)] if fwd else [(b,y-h),(a+tip,y-h),(a,y),(a+tip,y+h),(b,y+h)]
    ax.add_patch(mp.Polygon(pts,closed=True,fc=col,ec="black",lw=.6))
def colf(fun,name):
    if "FAH" in fun: return "#c1442e"
    if "LysR" in fun: return "#9aa5b1"
    if fun=="cyclase": return "#e8b63c"
    return "#6f9ac8"
YB, YH = 1.25, 0.0
for i,(n,s,e,st,fun) in enumerate(bj):
    a,b=xb[n]; fwd = (st=="-")       # minus-strand genes point right after reverse-complementing
    arrow(a,b,YB,fwd,colf(fun,n))
    xm=(a+b)/2
    ax.text(xm, YB+0.26+0.20*(i%2), n, fontsize=8.5, ha="center")
    ax.text(xm, YB+0.26+0.20*(i%2)+0.145, fun, fontsize=6.4, ha="center", color="#555")
for i,(n,s,e,st,fun) in enumerate(hs):
    a,b=xh[n]; fwd=(st=="+")
    arrow(a,b,YH,fwd,colf(fun,n))
    xm=(a+b)/2
    ax.text(xm, YH-0.33-0.20*(i%2), n, fontsize=8.5, ha="center", style="italic")
    ax.text(xm, YH-0.33-0.20*(i%2)-0.145, fun, fontsize=6.4, ha="center", color="#555")
for g,q in partner.items():
    x1=np.mean(xb[g]); x2=np.mean(xh[q])
    ax.plot([x1,x2],[YB-0.17,YH+0.17], color="#c3cbd6", lw=1.0, zorder=0)
    ax.text(0.52*x1+0.48*x2, 0.52*(YB-0.17)+0.48*(YH+0.17), f"{pid[g]:.0f}%", fontsize=7.2,
            ha="center", va="center", bbox=dict(fc="white",ec="none",pad=0.5))
ax.text(-10.9,YB,"B. diazoefficiens\nUSDA110", fontsize=9.5, ha="right", va="center", fontweight="bold")
ax.text(-10.9,YH,"H. seropedicae SmR1\nfde operon", fontsize=9.5, ha="right", va="center", fontweight="bold")
ax.annotate("fdeG cyclase has no\ncounterpart in the locus\n(69% identical gene lies\n396 kb away: BJA_RS30665)",
            xy=(np.mean(xh["fdeG"]), YH+0.2), xytext=(3.2, 0.95), fontsize=7.8, ha="left",
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color="#b07a10"), color="#8a5f07")
ax.set_xlim(-14.5,9.5); ax.set_ylim(-1.5,2.35)
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.spines[["top","right","left"]].set_visible(False)
ax.set_xlabel("kb from the first operon gene (USDA110 locus drawn reverse-complemented; both operons read left to right)")
ax.set_title("bll6422 is fdeI in a gene-for-gene syntenic copy of the H. seropedicae naringenin degradation operon\n(numbers: Smith-Waterman percent identity)", fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
